answer: Make identity expensive to fake and cheap to verify: require each agent to lock a small refundable stake that is slashed for proven misbehavior, and publish a crystal-clear work history on a public ledger. A newcomer with no record is like an uncut jade stone - potentially valuable, but trusted only for small jobs until repeated honest work proves it. A sudden gale of fresh accounts from one operator then costs real money per identity, while established agents keep their earned standing.
